categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-end intelligent equipment manufacturing, including new energy battery intelligent equipment manufacturing and organic silicon and polymer intelligent equipment manufacturing. It also engages in chemical product production such as organic silicon materials, new energy alkali metal materials, carbon-based silicon synthetic materials, and nano-powder. Key product lines include lithium (sodium) battery production equipment, organic silicon production equipment, and high-value comprehensive utilization of lithium mica products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced dual-screw continuous automatic production lines for lithium (sodium) battery electrode slurry and organic silicon materials. It has developed low-temperature sulfuric acid methods for lithium mica extraction, enabling high recovery rates of lithium, rubidium, cesium, potassium, and aluminum with low waste residue. The company integrates intelligent control systems, automated mixing, coating, rolling, and cutting technologies, and continuous production methods for organic silicon and polymer materials, emphasizing automation, energy efficiency, and environmental protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's customers are primarily in the new energy battery industry, including manufacturers of lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries for solid-state batteries, power batteries, energy storage batteries, and digital batteries. It also serves the organic silicon industry, supplying materials and equipment for sectors such as photovoltaics, aerospace, electronics, medical devices, and consumer goods. The company’s products are used in automotive, energy storage, aerospace, electronics, and chemical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and major facilities located in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries and operations in Jiangxi, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Yichun. The company also exports products internationally, with overseas sales accounting for a smaller portion of total revenue. It sources raw materials globally, including lithium mica from Africa and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures intelligent production equipment for battery electrode materials and organic silicon products and engages in the extraction and processing of lithium mica and rare metals like rubidium and cesium. It also develops and produces chemical materials used in battery manufacturing and other high-tech applications, positioning itself as both an equipment supplier and a materials producer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing solid-state battery dry electrode process equipment, expanding negative electrode material production lines, and enhancing lithium resource and rare metal extraction technologies. The company focuses on innovation in continuous production lines, intelligent automation, and environmental sustainability. It invests in recycling and circular economy systems for battery materials and develops new organic silicon foaming materials and production lines. R&D efforts emphasize improving production efficiency, product quality, and expanding applications in emerging sectors like aerospace and robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment and chemical products. The company sells complete production lines, single-piece equipment, and chemical materials such as lithium carbonate, rubidium salts, cesium salts, and organic silicon products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels domestically and internationally, with some revenue from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the new energy battery equipment sector, especially in lithium and sodium battery electrode slurry continuous production lines, holding over 95% market share in certain products. It is also a top domestic manufacturer in organic silicon equipment with the most comprehensive product lines and highest production volume. The company positions itself as a technology leader with proprietary innovations and a strong brand in both the lithium battery and organic silicon industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 1.51 billion RMB, a 33% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 80.7 million RMB. The decline was mainly due to reduced demand in the new energy sector and delayed project deliveries. Despite the downturn, the company’s lithium mica product segment grew significantly. Total assets were about 4.21 billion RMB, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company maintains a sizable workforce of over 1,400 employees, including 137 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced dual-screw continuous production technology, enabling high-efficiency, large-scale, and automated manufacturing with superior product quality and energy savings. Its proprietary low-temperature sulfuric acid lithium mica extraction technology offers high metal recovery rates with minimal environmental impact, differentiating it from traditional high-temperature methods. The company provides integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions covering the entire production process for lithium battery electrodes and organic silicon materials, supported by strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolios, positioning it as a comprehensive and innovative supplier in the new energy and chemical materials sectors.
